added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null and names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken.

findings.text: follow-on: the fragment says the warm re-read was made "through VirtualZarrView with a transport that raises if called", but VirtualZarrView.open (imas_ambix/data/virtual_zarr.py:98) opens the local Zarr group and carries no transport; the raising transport guards eddb.fetch_channels (scratch/cold_fetch_driver.py:211-213) while the view read (:217-222) touches no transport by construction, so the sentence describes a wiring that does not exist and a reader cannot reproduce the guard from it.

follow-on: the done-when names one ssh session per shot, but the gate makes two (scratch/cold_fetch_report.json transport_calls has four entries for two shots, each a fetch of 85 requests and a refusal-reason probe of 59), so the done-when's session count is not met; the fragment discloses the second session and the merged remote script discards a refused channel's reason, which is why the extra probe exists, but the deviation belongs in the record as a shortfall rather than only as prose.

follow-on: the manifest's follow-on states the refused PSRC set as "magPbTC1..35", but the driver requests magPbTC1..23 (scratch/cold_fetch_driver.py:43, range(1, 24)) and the fragment and done-when both say 1..23; 1+1+34+23=59 matches the refused count while 35 would give 71, so a reader sizing the PSRC set from the manifest follow-on is given the wrong extent.

follow_ons: the warm-read claim conflates the raising-transport guard with a VirtualZarrView that has no transport; the fragment sentence should be corrected when the extractor repair lands.

the extractor fetch_batch aborts a whole batch when any requested channel is refused (imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py:275-279), so a mixed batch cannot cold-fetch; the worker recorded this as its own follow-on and it is confirmed here.
the EDDB unit arrives as a list and is str()d to "['A']" (imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py:317-322); confirmed as observed, worker-recorded follow-on.
